## Appearance

Diana Barry is a very pretty and vivacious girl noted for her striking dark features. She has black eyes, jet-black glossy curls, rosy crimson cheeks, and dimples.

## Personality

Diana is a good, kind, and sweet individual known for her cheerful nature and humorous disposition that readily brings laughter to others. She possesses a practical outlook on life alongside a notable taste in dressing, which leads others to frequently seek out her advice on fashion.

## History

Diana Barry grew up in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), having received her first name from a visiting schoolmaster when she was born. In her youth, she spent her days with her close friend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), naming local landmarks such as Lover's Lane and imagining ghosts in the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood). She officially pledged a vow of eternal friendship to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family garden. Their bond faced an early trial when Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) temporarily separated them following an accidental wine incident, but Diana secretly met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a dramatic goodbye. Their full friendship was soon restored after Diana ran to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help when her baby sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), contracted severe croup; [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated the infant through the night, winning Mrs. Barry's complete gratitude and forgiveness. During their school years, Diana joined in community events, performing a solo at a school concert and later helping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for a benefit performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her peers formed the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), Diana active helped canvass the community for hall painting funds, tried to reason with neighbors regarding society goals, and joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a drive to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) to retrieve a willow-ware platter. While exploring the woods on a walk to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they met Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and shared a tea party. As the years progressed, Diana did not join the advanced class preparing for higher education, but she remained deeply loyal to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), celebrating Anne's academic triumphs and helping her prepare for major milestones. Eventually, Diana became secretly engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), sharing the news with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during the bustling preparations for Miss Lavendar's garden wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> “Everything went off very well,” said Diana practically. “I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

> "You’ll ruin your dress in that wet grain . . . ruin it. She doesn’t hear me! Well, she’ll never get that cow out by herself. I must go and help her, of course."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P14](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0014)

> "I’ve heard mother speak of it but I never saw it before, and I wouldn’t have supposed that it could be in existence still. You’ve heard the story, Anne?"
>
> — Diana Barry — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became instant, devoted friends from the moment they met in the Barrys' garden, swearing an oath of eternal friendship. Their bond survived temporary separations, such as when Diana's mother forbade them from seeing each other, but it was restored after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heroically nursed Diana's baby sister through severe croup. Throughout their school years and beyond, they share walks, local gossip, and personal triumphs, remaining deeply committed playmates and confidantes.

- Comrade of — close friends and playmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane.md)

Diana and [Jane](../character/jane.md) are regular companions, classmates, and fellow members of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). They spend peaceful afternoons exploring the woods, enjoying picnics, and listening to stories together, such as during a outing to Hester Gray's forgotten garden. Together with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), they participate in community efforts and navigate local events as close childhood friends.

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Diana and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are romantic partners who become secretly engaged to marry. ### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

Diana and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) met when Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally wandered down a wood lane and discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) welcomed them to an imaginative tea party. Diana becomes a frequent guest at the home, bringing warmth and cheer to Miss Lavendar's life. Diana later assists in the preparations for Miss Lavendar's garden wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).
